goals.objective: Goal: complete Todo 13-15 from .omo/plans/family-experience-market-ready-platform.md without feature expansion. Todo 13: Docker/runtime packaging production-safe validation. Todo 14: SLO, alert, incident response documentation. Todo 15: deploy-to-public-beta runbook. Constraints: no claim Docker/deploy complete unless verified; no raw secrets; use cache-first trust boundaries; PlayMCP/public submission not complete.
